title: Party Time

nodes.speaker: Ziggy RaSand
nodes.text: You're back! How'd it go? Did you secure the stuff? Can we have the party?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You're back! How'd it go? Did you secure the stuff? Can we have the party?

nodes.speaker: Ziggy RaSand
nodes.text: You.... That's just.... I mean.... There's people in this world and then there's good people.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You.... That's just.... I mean.... There's people in this world and then there's good people.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Whatever you say.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Whatever you say.

nodes.speaker: Ziggy RaSand
nodes.text: Well, you see, there's just something about birthdays, you know? It's a day when normal people, people like you and me and the ones we serve with our drinks and our food and our blood, sweat, and tears--sometimes literally--get to sit back and reap the rewards of our labor! Of our very EXISTENCE!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well, you see, there's just something about birthdays, you know? It's a day when normal people, people like you and me and the ones we serve with our drinks and our food and our blood, sweat, and tears--sometimes literally--get to sit back and reap the rewards of our labor! Of our very EXISTENCE!

nodes.speaker: Ziggy RaSand
nodes.text: RM said I'm ignoring her. R! M! said THAT. Yet she had NO problem ignoring the fact that what lies she spread caused so much bullshit for so many people?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: RM said I'm ignoring her. R! M! said THAT. Yet she had NO problem ignoring the fact that what lies she spread caused so much bullshit for so many people?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: How do you two know each other?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: How do you two know each other?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: How do you two know each other?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: How do you two know each other?

nodes.speaker: Ziggy RaSand
nodes.text: Ahhhh, well, that's a long story. She used to show up at these events I had. But she'd always come at the end, right? Stay for a few minutes maybe a half hour tops, then dip out with someone. Dudes. Chicks. Android. Didn't matter, whatever clung to her.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Ahhhh, well, that's a long story. She used to show up at these events I had. But she'd always come at the end, right? Stay for a few minutes maybe a half hour tops, then dip out with someone. Dudes. Chicks. Android. Didn't matter, whatever clung to her.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Isn't she a medic?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Isn't she a medic?

nodes.speaker: Ziggy RaSand
nodes.text: Yeah. Gods and Lights, those parties were the fuckin' best.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yeah. Gods and Lights, those parties were the fuckin' best.

nodes.speaker: Ziggy RaSand
nodes.text: So what'd she wail yah for the bag? I told her I'd cover the cost by getting her VIP to this shimmer fest but she wasn't having it. Despite the fact that we're gettin' an ice luge with ACTUAL ice.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So what'd she wail yah for the bag? I told her I'd cover the cost by getting her VIP to this shimmer fest but she wasn't having it. Despite the fact that we're gettin' an ice luge with ACTUAL ice.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Nothing.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Nothing.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: 500 lims.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: 500 lims.

nodes.speaker: Ziggy RaSand
nodes.text: FIVE HUNDRED! For the love of every neon light in this glass and concrete cell block! Ugh. Whatever. I need this party to be the redux. The 'Welcome Back'.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: FIVE HUNDRED! For the love of every neon light in this glass and concrete cell block! Ugh. Whatever. I need this party to be the redux. The 'Welcome Back'.

nodes.speaker: Ziggy RaSand
nodes.text: Seriously? Wow. I was NOT expecting that. I mean, it's the right thing to do after she spread all those rumors around. Maybe she's taking stock in her actions.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Seriously? Wow. I was NOT expecting that. I mean, it's the right thing to do after she spread all those rumors around. Maybe she's taking stock in her actions.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: So... The LICCY?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So... The LICCY?

nodes.speaker: Ziggy RaSand
nodes.text: Oh, yeah! Word is bond and mine is as strong as those nanofiber cuffs the 'Sec's got. Here yah go.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Oh, yeah! Word is bond and mine is as strong as those nanofiber cuffs the 'Sec's got. Here yah go.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Thanks.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Thanks.

nodes.speaker: Ziggy RaSand
nodes.text: You earned it. I'll let you know when the party is, really get our business talk going. I got some luscious ideas for your libations.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You earned it. I'll let you know when the party is, really get our business talk going. I got some luscious ideas for your libations.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I did.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I did.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Why is this party SO important?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Why is this party SO important?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Why is this party SO important?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Why is this party SO important?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: RM said you're ignoring her.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: RM said you're ignoring her.
